description.intro: The short Stadium from Inter 2025/2026 reproduces the official design of the team with comfort, lightness and Nerazzurro style. Perfect to complete your look or feel part of the eleven headline.
key_benefits: Official design: Part of the original equipment of Inter 25/26.
Effective breathability: Dri-FIT technology to maintain freshness.
Comfortable fit: Regular cut with elastic waist.
Timeless style: Black color with embroidered club shield.
Uso polivalente: Ideal para jugar, entrenar o animar al equipo.
